They are best known for their [[association football|football]] club but are represented in many sports such as [[basketball]], [[volleyball]], [[boxing]], and in the past [[ice hockey]], [[sport of athletics|athletics]], [[tennis]], [[table tennis]], [[Swimming (sport)|swimming]], [[cycling]], [[fencing]], [[chess]], etc. The club is based at [[Władysław Król Municipal Stadium]], at Aleja [[Union of Lublin|Unii Lubelskiej]] 2 in the West of Łódź. This article focuses on the football club. Their nickname "''Rycerze Wiosny''" ("Knights of Spring") was given to them due to their usually strong performances after the winter break in the league."}}
